_docs: Brand values for every email LifeOS sends (LIFEOS/TOOLS/EmailTemplate.ts loadBrand(): this object is spread over the built-in defaults, so any key you omit keeps its default). name = banner wordmark; bannerBg = banner color (hex); logoUrl = HOSTED image URL for the banner mark, never a filesystem path (empty hides the logo); company = company line in the footer; supportEmail = footer contact (empty hides it); footerBrand = the 'Sent by' line.
